description: This file implements the SiftStore class, which manages a local data store (likely a database or key-value store) to handle event entries within the RDK framework. It provides methods to initialize the store, retrieve event counts, fetch events, remove events, and add new events, all with thread safety via mutex locking.

classes.name: SiftStore
classes.description: A class that manages event storage using a local store, providing thread-safe operations to add, retrieve, and remove event entries.

methods.name: SiftStore::SiftStore
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the store, creates a table, and sets an event limit.

methods.name: SiftStore::GetEventCount
methods.description: Returns the count of events and entries within the store as a pair.

methods.name: SiftStore::GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of event entries starting from a specific index with a specified count.

methods.name: SiftStore::RemoveEvents
methods.description: Removes a range of events identified by start and end indices.

methods.name: SiftStore::PostEvent
methods.description: Adds a new event entry to the store.
